Your bookmark manager is built and ready for review. The broker will start it at `http://maker:4000`.

## What it does

A full-stack bookmark app with persistent storage:

- **Add / edit / delete** bookmarks — each has a URL, title, description, and tags
- **Search** — live filtering across title, URL, description, and tags
- **Tag sidebar** — click any tag to filter; shows counts, auto-updates
- **Smart URLs** — bare domains like `github.com` get `https://` added; title defaults to the URL if left blank
- **Persistence** — stored in SQLite (`bookmarks.db`), survives restarts

## Stack

| Part | Choice |
|------|--------|
| Server | Express (`server.js`), listening on `0.0.0.0:4000` |
| Storage | SQLite via `better-sqlite3` |
| Frontend | Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS in `public/` (no build step) |
| API | REST: `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/bookmarks`, `GET /api/tags` |

I smoke-tested the API (create, list, tags, static serving) and all endpoints respond correctly. HTML is escaped on render to prevent XSS from stored data.

Run locally with `npm start`.

A few directions I could take it next if you'd like: auto-fetching page titles from URLs, import/export (browser bookmarks / JSON), favicons, or multi-user accounts with login. Want any of these?
